name: Knowledge bases
summary: Foundry Knowledge Bases attached to an agent, backed by a BYOM-routed embedding/chat model.
description: Knowledge bases require a deployed model (typically an embedding model for ingestion and a chat model at query time). Initial observation is that the Knowledge Base configuration only accepts a Foundry-native model deployment and does not honor an AI-Gateway / APIM-routed BYOM connection — needs to be re-verified end-to-end before we mark it as not_supported.
notes: Status-only card. Suspected unsupported (knowledge-base config doesn't appear to accept an AI-Gateway connection), but needs hands-on confirmation.
